title: FinOps - Simply Explained
description:
Most companies discover they are overspending on cloud only when the invoice lands. This episode explains FinOps in plain language for beginners, IT pros and finance teams: its principles, its inform-optimize-operate loop and the tools already inside Microsoft 365 and Azure. You will learn how to start with one alert and one owner, and which mistakes to avoid.
In this episode
00:00 – Why cloud costs feel out of control01:34 – What FinOps actually means03:49 – The six FinOps principles05:47 – Inform, optimize, operate07:29 – FinOps on a normal Tuesday09:06 – FinOps tools in Microsoft 365 and Azure11:37 – Mistakes that sink a FinOps practice12:58 – What FinOps cannot fix
Key takeaways
FinOps is a shared cultural practice between the people who build with technology and the people who pay for it, aimed at getting the most value rather than only cutting costs.The practice runs on six principles and a repeating loop of inform, optimize and operate, with visibility through tagging and showback as the foundation.Microsoft Cost Management, Azure Advisor, commitment discounts and the Microsoft 365 admin center give you the starting tools, but only ownership and habits keep the savings.
Worth quoting
“FinOps isn't a product you buy, and it isn't a single job title you can hire for.” – Mirko Peters (01:52)
“Sometimes the smart move is to spend more on something that earns more, and the practice gives you the numbers to make that call with confidence.” – Mirko Peters (02:15)
